paragraphs: An open Salmonella outbreak linked to broccoli sprouts has grown to 32 cases across six states, with three hospitalizations reported [1]. The outbreak is associated with recalled broccoli sprouts traced to Evergreen Fresh Sprouts LLC [11]. Consumers should avoid broccoli sprouts from this source and contact a healthcare provider if they develop symptoms [1].

A Class I recall of raw pork, beef, and goat products from Star Meat Delivery Inc. of Lucama, North Carolina involves more than 83 tons of meat produced without federal inspection and bearing fake USDA inspection marks [3][20]. Consumers who purchased A&D Foods "GOAT CUT 1-1/2" products or other items from this company should not consume them [3][20].

An outbreak of E. coli O145 linked to frozen blueberries is now over [2]. The outbreak affected 17 people across two states with six hospitalizations and no deaths [2]. Deano's Pasta is recalling Pear and Pecorino Triangoli Ravioli due to undeclared lobster that poses a risk to those with crustacean shellfish allergies [4]. GF Blends is recalling Truly AIP All Purpose Flour and Bread Mix and EAT G.A.N.G.S.T.E.R. Flat Bread Pizza Mix for potential undeclared wheat gluten [8]. Berlin Seeds is recalling 950 pounds of alfalfa sprouting seed due to potential contamination with Shiga toxin-producing E. coli and Salmonella [6]. Galil Importing Corp is recalling Lior Cinnamon Ground Seasoning due to elevated lead levels [5].
